hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored ksNormalityTest reproduces BOTH scipy.stats.kstest AND base R ks.test D statistic BIT-FOR-BIT; and KS does NOT reject normality (its p-value exceeds 0.05) even though Jarque-Bera does -- the moment-based and CDF-based normality tests disagree.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: ksNormalityTest equals scipy.stats.kstest AND base R ks.test D to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 vs each)
